capitol.en: The class studied the capitol building as part of a civics lesson.
capitol.zh: 全班在公民課中研究了議會大廈。

careless.en: A careless mistake changed the final answer on the worksheet.
careless.zh: 一個粗心的錯誤改變了學習單上的最後答案。

carp.en: A carp swam slowly near the edge of the pond.
carp.zh: 一條鯉魚慢慢游在池塘邊。

cassette.en: The museum displayed an old cassette beside a portable player.
cassette.zh: 博物館在隨身播放器旁展示了一卷舊卡帶。

caste.en: The history chapter explains how caste shaped parts of society.
caste.zh: 歷史章節說明種姓制度如何影響部分社會。

casually.en: She casually mentioned the idea during lunch with her classmates.
casually.zh: 她和同學吃午餐時隨口提到這個想法。

catcher.en: The catcher signaled to the pitcher before the next play.
catcher.zh: 下一個球開始前，捕手向投手打出暗號。

causal.en: The study found a possible causal link between the two factors.
causal.zh: 研究發現這兩個因素之間可能存在因果關係。

cautiously.en: The hikers moved cautiously across the wet wooden bridge.
cautiously.zh: 健行者小心地走過濕滑的木橋。

cd.en: He found an old cd in a box of music albums.
cd.zh: 他在一箱音樂專輯裡找到一張舊光碟。

cellar.en: The old house has a cool cellar beneath the kitchen.
cellar.zh: 那棟老房子的廚房下方有一間陰涼地窖。

centigrade.en: The thermometer showed twenty degrees centigrade in the classroom.
centigrade.zh: 教室裡的溫度計顯示攝氏二十度。

ceremonious.en: The award presentation was brief but still quite ceremonious.
ceremonious.zh: 頒獎過程雖然簡短，仍然相當隆重。

challenging.en: The final puzzle was challenging but possible with careful teamwork.
challenging.zh: 最後一道謎題很有挑戰性，但靠合作仍能解開。

chancellor.en: The university chancellor welcomed new students at the opening ceremony.
chancellor.zh: 大學校長在開學典禮上歡迎新生。

changeable.en: Mountain weather can be changeable even during a clear morning.
changeable.zh: 即使早晨晴朗，山區天氣仍可能多變。

charming.en: The small town has a charming square beside the river.
charming.zh: 這座小鎮在河邊有一個迷人的廣場。

chatterbox.en: The friendly chatterbox kept everyone entertained during the long wait.
chatterbox.zh: 那位健談的人在漫長等待中讓大家不覺無聊。

checkbook.en: The exhibit included an old checkbook from a local business.
checkbook.zh: 展覽中包含一本來自當地商家的舊支票簿。

cheerleader.en: A cheerleader led the crowd in supporting the school team.
cheerleader.zh: 一名啦啦隊員帶領觀眾為校隊加油。

cheers.en: Loud cheers filled the gym after the final point.
cheers.zh: 最後一分結束後，體育館裡充滿歡呼聲。

chessboard.en: The pieces were arranged neatly across the wooden chessboard.
chessboard.zh: 棋子整齊地排列在木製西洋棋盤上。

chick.en: A yellow chick followed the hen across the farmyard.
chick.zh: 一隻黃色小雞跟著母雞走過農家庭院。

childcare.en: The community center offers childcare during evening classes for parents.
childcare.zh: 社區中心在家長晚間上課時提供托育服務。

childlike.en: Her childlike curiosity made the science exhibit especially enjoyable.
childlike.zh: 她像孩子般的好奇心讓科學展覽特別有趣。

civics.en: Our civics class discussed how local governments provide public services.
civics.zh: 公民課討論地方政府如何提供公共服務。

cleaning.en: The cleaning staff prepared the hall before the morning event.
cleaning.zh: 清潔人員在早晨活動前整理好大廳。

clockwork.en: The old clockwork mechanism still moves after many years.
clockwork.zh: 這套老式發條機械經過多年仍能運轉。

clutch.en: She held the folder in a tight clutch during the windy walk.
clutch.zh: 風很大時，她緊緊抓著資料夾走路。

coastguard.en: The coastguard monitored weather conditions near the harbor that morning.
coastguard.zh: 海岸巡防人員那天早上監測港口附近的天候。

cockpit.en: The museum lets visitors view a historic aircraft cockpit.
cockpit.zh: 博物館讓遊客參觀一架歷史飛機的駕駛艙。

coed.en: The article describes the transition to a coed school system.
coed.zh: 文章描述學校制度轉為男女合校的過程。

coeducation.en: The report examines the history of coeducation in public schools.
coeducation.zh: 報告探討公立學校男女合校教育的歷史。

collaborate.en: Students collaborate on a research project about local history.
collaborate.zh: 學生合作進行一項關於地方歷史的研究專題。

comfortably.en: Four students can sit comfortably around the small table.
comfortably.zh: 四名學生可以舒適地坐在這張小桌旁。

comforting.en: Her comforting words helped the group remain calm before presenting.
comforting.zh: 她安慰的話讓小組在報告前保持冷靜。

coming.en: The coming semester will include several new science activities.
coming.zh: 即將到來的學期會加入幾項新的科學活動。

commemorate.en: The school planted a tree to commemorate its anniversary.
commemorate.zh: 學校種了一棵樹來紀念校慶。

commend.en: Teachers often commend students who help others without being asked.
commend.zh: 老師常稱讚主動幫助別人的學生。

communal.en: The building has a communal kitchen shared by all residents.
communal.zh: 這棟建築有一間所有住戶共用的廚房。

companionship.en: The story emphasizes friendship and companionship during difficult journeys.
companionship.zh: 故事強調艱難旅程中的友誼與陪伴。

comparatively.en: This route is comparatively short when measured against the older one.
comparatively.zh: 和舊路線相比，這條路線相對較短。

compartment.en: She stored the charger in a small compartment of her backpack.
compartment.zh: 她把充電器放在背包的一個小隔層裡。

composite.en: The bridge uses a composite material that combines several substances.
composite.zh: 這座橋使用由多種材料組成的複合材質。

comprehensible.en: The diagram made the difficult process more comprehensible to students.
comprehensible.zh: 這張圖讓學生更容易理解困難的流程。

compress.en: The software can compress large files before they are uploaded.
compress.zh: 這套軟體可以在上傳前壓縮大型檔案。

confide.en: She chose to confide in a trusted teacher about the problem.
confide.zh: 她選擇向一位信任的老師說明問題。

confidently.en: He confidently explained the experiment to the visiting judges.
confidently.zh: 他自信地向來訪評審說明實驗。

conjunction.en: The teacher showed how a conjunction can connect two ideas.
conjunction.zh: 老師示範連接詞如何連接兩個想法。

consciously.en: She consciously slowed her speech during the English presentation.
consciously.zh: 她在英文報告時刻意放慢說話速度。
